channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: ElevenLabs bags $500 million in funding, valuation bits $11 billion
item.description: ElevenLabs is now valued at $11 billion, with total funding of $781 million across five rounds.

item.title: Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCL Tech, TechM: Cues for Indian IT from Cognizant Q4 results
item.description: TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech: Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities said the increase in discretionary spending called out by Cognizant, especially in the BFSI vertical in North America is a strong positive for the Indian IT industry.

item.title: India could become the world’s AI inferencing capital as $20 bots challenge entry-level engineers, says Abhishek Singh
item.description: As $20 AI bots challenge entry-level engineers, India bets on inference and agentic AI to protect its $250-billion IT industry

item.title: Bharat Taxi goes live in Delhi today: Govt-backed app promises cheaper rides as against Uber, Ola
item.description: The app will be formally launched at 3 pm on February 5, 2026, by Union Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah, marking the start of a nationwide rollout planned in phases

item.title: RBI MPC 2026: Rate cut or hold? Here's what JM Financial says
item.description: JM Financial said the bond markets appear to be detached from the RBI's policy actions since June 2025, as reflected by the widening wedge between the policy rate and benchmark yield.

item.title: JSW Cement shares jump 9% after Q3 turnaround from loss to profit, expansion updates
item.description: The company’s board approved the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary in Fujairah, UAE. The new entity will set up a cement grinding unit with a capacity of 1.65 million tonnes per annum (MTPA), the company informed exchanges.

item.title: 9-12% of IT services revenue stands to be eliminated: MOFSL on Anthropic, Palantir impact
item.description: Amid the ongoing rout in IT stocks, domestic brokerage firm Motilal Oswal Financial Services believes 9-12 per cent of IT services revenue stands to be eliminated.
